a $1B award under the CHIPS Act from the US Department of Commerce, with the funding set to support research and development aimed at expanding US quantum wafer manufacturing capabilities.
The award follows a letter of intent announced in May between the Commerce Department and IBM. Anderon is also backed by an additional $1B investment from IBM.
Based in Albany, New York, Anderon operates a 300-millimeter pure-play quantum wafer foundry designed to serve customers across the broader quantum technology industry.

title: IBM’s Anderon finalizes $1B chips award with US Commerce Department
